lessons: Rate-table completeness was the whole story here. The published fare table has six distance rings by three contract types by two mode groups; the skill carried five cells of it (yellow bus/train, green bus, light-blue bus, national monthly) and no daily-pass amount at all. Any future cycle must re-diff bus.gov.il/FaresDistance row by row, not spot-check the yellow ring.

The discount surface is 13 separate authority profile pages. Before this cycle the skill listed six. Re-enumerate the profile links on bus.gov.il/discounts each cycle; the authority adds profiles without changing the summary table.

scripts/check_transit.py had drifted to a fabricated '9 NIS raised from 8 NIS on Jan 1, 2026' single fare while SKILL.md said 8. Scripts are the surface nobody re-reads. Grep every hardcoded amount in scripts/ against the body on every cycle.
